name: Crit-rider test (Craterflesh +1d6 Force on crit, doubled; Life Stealing +10 Necrotic flat on crit)
_note: Longsword 1d8+5 str, AC15 (atk+6, p_hit 0.6 p_crit 0.05). On crit: weapon 2d8(9)+5=14, Craterflesh 2d6(7) Force (doubled by crit), Life Stealing +10 Necrotic (flat, not doubled). Non-crit per hit: 4.5+5=9.5. Crit per hit: 14+7+10=31. EV=0.55*9.5+0.05*31=5.225+1.55=6.775.
